description: Final Phase 1 particle-separation baseline after correcting T3PA fine timestamp handling and visually retuning DBSCAN on crowded slices. Uses proper Timepix time ticks: hit_time = ToA - FToA / 16. Clustering distance is Euclidean in (x, y, hit_time / time_scale). Energy is preserved but excluded from distance.
notes: This replaces dbscan_v001 for particle-shard generation and Phase 2 training data.
The old dbscan_v001 backend agreement remains useful for implementation validation only, but its parameters are not trusted as physical particle labels.
The eps5 aligned-time pass was reestimated over all 711 local .t3pa files into local_data/processed/particles_aligned_time_eps5_v001/.
Weighted full-data noise fraction was 0.024 over 44,725,206 hits.
The densest observed file remained faster than real time: 12.209 s runtime for 15.632 s physical duration, RT fraction 0.781.
The largest file data I05/sync__I05-W0044_r001.t3pa ran in 36.063 s for 59.789 s physical duration, RT fraction 0.603.

params.time_axis: ToA - FToA / 16 in 25 ns tick units
